admin.admin_maint_lang_stats_help: Counts topics by content language with new topics in the last 30 days, to decide whether language sections are worth enabling. The aggregation scans the whole table and is cached for 10 minutes; run it on demand.

admin.setting_content_lang_hint: Filter topic lists by the language of the post content. When off, behavior is unchanged. When on, a language filter bar appears and new posts are auto-detected (editable). Existing posts only participate after their language is backfilled.
admin.admin_budget_note: Note: hard limit {hard_d1_queries} D1 queries/request; the above values are real accumulations for this runtime request, not site-wide daily averages.
admin.admin_email_help: Configure multiple SMTP accounts (recommend 465 implicit TLS or 587 STARTTLS; port 25 is blocked on Cloudflare Workers). Sending rotates across accounts to spread quota; on single-account failure it auto-switches to the next. Each account can set a daily send limit (0 = unlimited); when reached, that account is skipped for the day and auto-resumes the next day. If all accounts are empty, registration verification and password-reset emails are not sent (other features are unaffected).
admin.admin_email_note: Note: passwords are encrypted at rest and never displayed. QQ/163 and similar personal mailboxes require enabling SMTP in their settings and using an "auth code" as the password; the from address must match the login account (most providers enforce this).

admin.admin_maint_r2_note_scope: Only the avatar, forum, site, attach and seo prefixes are listed; tmp/ and any unknown prefix are never touched (temporary files belong to Cron and the bucket lifecycle rule). Objects uploaded less than {n} hours ago are always skipped, so an attachment that is uploaded but not yet posted is never removed.
admin.admin_maint_r2_note_confirm: The delete button only becomes available after a full scan that found at least one object; scanning advances page by page and progress is kept for 7 days, so you can continue or reset at any time.
